items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: it was some other player, trombone player that used to do comedy with Lionel Hampton called Sloane

ctx.x: Played guitar. And Vernon Alley was the bass player from San Francisco, and Lee Young, Lester Young's brother was a drummer. He was later replaced by Shadow Wilson in Chicago. And we had -- I don't remember all the players but as I said there was this -- Fred Beckett was in the band, the trombone player, and it was some other player, trombone player that used to do comedy with Lionel Hampton called Sloane. He was a little fella from Texas somewhere. And then there was Dexter Gordon.
I was just going to say was there another tenor saxophone player.
